DIAGNOSTICS - AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U240E)
P0750 Shift Solenoid A Malfunction OTC (Shift Solenoid, Valve SL 1)
P0755 Shift Solenoid B Malfunction OTC (Shift Solenold Valve SL2)
P0765 Shift Solenold O Malfunction OTC (Shift Solenold Valve S4)
SYSTEM DESCRIPTION
The ECM uses signals from the vehicle speed sensor to detect the actual gear position (1st, 2nd, 3rd or 0/D
gear).
Then the ECM compares the actual gear with the shift schedule in the ECM memory to detect mechanical
trouble of the shift solenoid valves and valve body.
